title: MILimbEEG
description: MILimbEEG is an EEG dataset of over 8,680 four-second recordings from 60 volunteers performing and imagining upper- and lower-limb movements. The movements are left and right hand closing and dorsal and plantar foot flexion, with baseline eyes-open and rest conditions. Signals were recorded with a 16-channel dry-electrode OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy system at 125 Hz. The participants include healthy individuals, amputees and post-COVID-19 individuals. The dataset supports brain-computer interface research.
methods_description: Sixty volunteers each completed one session in which they performed and then imagined hand closing and foot flexion movements, plus baseline eyes-open and rest periods, following visual cues. EEG was recorded from 16 dry electrodes (10-10 montage) with an OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy at 125 Hz, referenced to a neutral ear electrode. Hardware filtering applied a 5-50 Hz band-pass and a 60 Hz notch.
